headline: Active Sectors Renew Pressure Along Divided Front
war_summary: The latest returns show movement concentrated in a handful of sectors, with several fronts busier than in the previous edition. FishermansRowHex now leads the ledger with forty-six strategic-base events in twenty-four hours, including five in the past two; its holdings stand at six Colonial, two Warden, and one neutral base. WeatheredExpanseHex has recorded forty-two daily events and six in two hours, while its divided line remains five Warden to four Colonial. StlicanShelfHex has reached thirty-five daily events but has gone quiet in the latest two-hour window, with seven Warden and two Colonial bases. MooringCountyHex has resumed activity with three recent events and nineteen across the day, retaining twelve Warden bases. StonecradleHex has registered five events in two hours and twelve over the day, with five Warden and four Colonial positions. LinnMercyHex is also active, posting two recent and fifteen daily events; its current count is ten Colonial, one Warden. CallahansPassageHex remains a heavily fought but presently quiet sector, with three events over the day and no fresh movement in two hours.
